title: π-HuB: the proteomic navigator of the human body

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《π-HuB: the proteomic navigator of the human body》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Recent advances in proteomic technology and computational sciences now provide opportunities to investigate the intricate biology of the human body at unprecedented resolution and scale.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】The aim of the π-HuB project is to (1) generate and harness multimodality proteomic datasets to enhance our understanding of human biology; (2) facilitate disease risk assessment and diagnosis; (3) uncover new drug targets; (4) optimize appropriate therapeutic strategies; and (5) enable intelligent healthcare, thereby ushering in a new era of proteomics-driven phronesis medicine.
